candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Di pikin get fever wey don last for 2 days. E no dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Di body temperature na 38.0°C. No sign say pikin get rash for body. No identified bacterial cause for di fever. Malaria risk dey high, malaria test dey available, but malaria test show negative. E never cough for measles and e never get measles inside di last 3 months. No obvious cause of fever we see. Eye no red. E no get catarrh. Neck no stiff. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E get fever.
